changes.evidence: Nelson and Murdock is dissolved in Daredevil S2 episode 9 ('Seven Minutes in Heaven'): Foggy packs up the office and tells Karen the firm is no more; Matt has no firm until Nelson, Murdock & Page at the end of S3.

Penny's Place is her family's diner in Fagan Corners, Vermont, where she worked in 2006 before leaving for New York; it appears only in the S3 episode 10 ('Karen') flashback. She is not part of it at any point from Daredevil S1 on, and in S3 she is with the Bulletin until Nelson, Murdock & Page.

In Daredevil S1 episode 12, Ellison refuses to run Ben's Fisk story and fires him (wiki section 'Fired from The Bulletin'; 'worked at the New York Bulletin until shortly before his death when he was fired'). Fisk kills him afterward, so he dies no longer at the Bulletin.

In Daredevil S2 episodes 9-11, Elektra tells Stick to leave and that she will fight the Hand without the Chaste. Stick then sends Chaste assassin Duchamps to kill her ('Target of the Chaste'), and she hunts Stick down and kills his men. She fights the Hand beside Matt, outside the Chaste, until her death in episode 13. Her wiki affiliation lists the Chaste as 'formerly'.

At the end of Daredevil: Born Again S1 (episode 9), Matt and Karen walk into Josie's Bar, where Cherry, Josie, Angie Kim and NYPD officers are waiting, ready to fight Fisk's regime. The wiki lists Josie as a (former) member of Daredevil's Army, and in BA S2 episode 2 her bar is the resistance's hideout until the Task Force raids it. She still runs the bar the whole time.
